title: Add adversarial security tests for paths, auth, cgroups, snapshots, OCI input, and isolation

cargo_test.note: Deterministic lane: 9 integration targets (adversarial, path_security, binary_security, cgroup_security, auth_security, network_security, snapshot_security, oci_security, scope_fidelity). No root, /dev/kvm, /dev/net/tun, writable cgroupfs, or pinned binary required.

cargo_test_privileged.note: Privileged-gated tests (real-kernel cgroup no-internal-process EBUSY; real nft ruleset load) compile and skip gracefully on a non-root host.

evidence_artifacts.note: Each domain battery writes a per-domain artifact (class=security) recording, per probe, the expected and actual typed ErrorCode and pass/fail. All 9 artifacts validate against schemas/evidence-security.v1.json and their summaries reconcile (total==items.length, pass+fail==total).

methodology.not_grep_only: Every probe drives the production code path (open the real PathResolver, verify a real synthetic binary, build the real jailer argv, run the real CompatibilityGate, import a real on-disk OCI layout, parse the real clap CLI, parse the generated nftables ruleset into a reachability model) and observes the typed ErrorCode returned. Source-text scans appear ONLY in scope_fidelity.rs as a secondary, comment-aware layer, each paired with a behavioral proof (clap flag rejection, serialized config-surface key absence, exhaustive NetworkPolicy match).
methodology.typed_error_per_failure: Each probe records expected_code and actual_code; a hostile input that unexpectedly succeeds is recorded as actual_code='bypass' and fails the battery. The harness canary (path_security::harness_canary..., adversarial::scan_detector_catches_a_planted_violation) proves a successful bypass flips the probe to fail.
methodology.evidence_before_assert: run_battery() writes the artifact to disk before the caller asserts no bypass, so a detected bypass still leaves an evidence artifact behind.
methodology.pre_spawn: All exercised boundaries are pure, pre-spawn functions (validate_*, verify_bytes, JailerArgv::build, CompatibilityGate::validate, validate_local_reference, scan_forbidden); no probe spawns a process or mutates host policy, so the suite fails on a bypass before any privileged side effect.
methodology.disposable_namespace: No host policy is modified. Filesystem probes use tempfile tempdirs; cgroup probes use a simulated hierarchy in a tempdir; the only real-kernel mutations (cgroup no-internal-process, nft load) are behind the `privileged` feature, create a disposable test cgroup/table, clean up after themselves, and skip without root.

acceptance_criteria.cgroup_version_2: cgroup_security: CGROUP_VERSION==2; jailer_command argv and JailerArgv always contain --cgroup-version=2 and never =1. Probe: cgroup_security/jailer_root_uid etc.
acceptance_criteria.release_static_binary_hash: binary_security: BinaryVerifier recomputes SHA-256 and requires an exact match against the pinned manifest; hash_mismatch, dynamic_binary (PT_INTERP), debug_build (.debug_*), machine_mismatch, version_mismatch, not_pinned, non-ELF/ELF32/ET_REL all rejected with BinaryProvenanceError. adversarial: every single-byte mutation of a genuine binary is caught (hash gate).
acceptance_criteria.jailer_path_symlink_rejection: path_security: a clean-named symlink to /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow, a symlinked directory component, a magic-link (/proc/self/fd) target, and a symlinked tenant root are all refused with PathEscape by the real openat2/O_NOFOLLOW resolver; the fallback walk is independently safe. adversarial: bypass_clean_named_symlink canary.
acceptance_criteria.peer_credential_denial: auth_security: get_peer_credentials extracts real SO_PEERCRED creds over a Unix socketpair; StaticAuthenticator/RootOnlyAuthenticator return None (denial) for a wrong/non-root UID; end-to-end peer->principal denial. Probes: peer_cred_wrong_uid_denied, root_only_non_root_denied.
acceptance_criteria.cgroup_no_internal_process: cgroup_security: the parent delegates controllers (non-empty subtree_control => kernel no-internal-process domain) while the leaf is a true leaf (empty subtree_control, no children); verify_leaf rejects a leaf that gains a child or a delegated controller (InvalidResourceSpec). privileged: real-kernel EBUSY on cgroup.procs of a delegating parent (gated).
acceptance_criteria.inter_vm_network_denial: network_security: the generated nftables script is parsed into a forward-chain reachability model; default policy is drop and no guest can reach another guest's address (only its own gateway), while NatOnly masquerade is destination-scoped to the host subnet. AddressAllocator gives distinct, non-overlapping per-VM addresses; double-allocation is rejected. privileged: real nft load (gated).
acceptance_criteria.snapshot_tamper_compatibility: snapshot_security: verify_artifacts detects tampering of any content hash (kernel/rootfs/memory/vmstate/block-device) and missing/extra block devices (DigestMismatch); CompatibilityGate rejects foreign owner (PermissionDenied), unsupported schema, binary version/hash mismatch, CPU arch/model/flag mismatch, KVM API mismatch, cgroup-v1 manifest, non-immutable memory (SnapshotIncompatible), and quota overflow (QuotaExceeded) -- all before any Firecracker load.
acceptance_criteria.local_only_oci: oci_security: validate_local_reference and OciImporter::open_reference reject remote/tag-only/digest-pinned references and file://remote-host (LocalArtifactRequired) before I/O; remote descriptor urls rejected; layer/config digest+size mismatch (DigestMismatch); missing blob (ArtifactNotFound); unsupported/mismatched platform; missing/duplicate media; malformed digest; invalid manifest shape.
acceptance_criteria.no_tcp_rootless_vfio_live_migration_flag: scope_fidelity: the real clap parser rejects --tcp/--rootless/--vfio/--live-migration/--mount/--cap-add/--privileged/--host-network/--pid/--ipc on create/run/global positions while accepting legitimate flags; serialized BootConfig/NetworkBootConfig/ResourceSpec/MicroVmSpec carry no forbidden keys; NetworkPolicy is exhaustively {None,NatOnly,EgressAllowed}; comment-aware source scan finds no TCP-listener type in control-plane crates and no rootless/vfio/live-migration identifier in product code.
acceptance_criteria.typed_error_and_evidence_per_failure: Every probe records expected_code/actual_code into a per-domain security-evidence artifact (schemas/evidence-security.v1.json); 134 battery probes across 9 domains, all pass, 0 bypasses.

exclusions_honored: no grep-only checks as the sole security proof (source scans are secondary, comment-aware, and paired with behavioral proofs)
no host-policy modification without a disposable test namespace (real-kernel probes are privileged-gated, use a disposable test cgroup/table, clean up, and skip without root)
deterministic default run requires no root, /dev/kvm, /dev/net/tun, writable cgroupfs, or pinned Firecracker/jailer binary
no production code added (test-only crate; [dependencies] empty)
